title: Aerospace Corp executives questioned in a SCIF

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. And so we we actually sent a letter early on to Aerospace Corp. um and the oversight committee um from our role from my role to be able to get them to come in and answer some questions and they actually responded and they sent um someone two people from their executive team but of course they knew nothing.

plain: Around 2023 or 2024, a congressional committee that checks on the government sent a letter to a company called Aerospace Corp, and two members of its executive team came to a secure classified room in Washington to answer questions, but they said they knew nothing. Congressman Eric Burlison tells this from his own role in getting them there. He tells it as an example of hitting a wall when asking companies about secret UFO work.
